name: Sage
description: A small shrub with soft, grey-green, velvety leaves and a strong, savoury smell. Purple-blue flowers appear in early summer.

uses.title: Kitchen
uses.text: Butter sauces, pasta, stuffing and roasted pumpkin.

uses.title: Tea
uses.text: Sage tea is a traditional drink in many countries.

growingTips.title: Soil
growingTips.text: Light, well-drained soil; it hates wet feet.

growingTips.title: Water
growingTips.text: Water young plants; older plants need very little.

growingTips.title: Renewal
growingTips.text: Cut it back in spring and replace the plant every few years when it gets woody.
